Q1. What exactly should be improved in this repository?
Choices:
A. A workflow/job/step — name the workflow file and the undesired behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. A script/helper/module — name the file or function and the problem to fix (RECOMMENDED)
C. Documentation/onboarding — name the file/section and what is missing or confusing (RECOMMENDED)
D. Something else — name the exact file/path and desired change (RECOMMENDED)
Q2. What kind of improvement do you want?
Choices:
A. Fix a bug/regression — describe current behavior and expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Improve reliability/flakiness — name the failing workflow/job/step and symptom (RECOMMENDED)
C. Improve performance/cost — state what is too slow/expensive and the target improvement
D. Improve usability/docs — state what is hard to use and the desired outcome
Q3. What should count as done?
Choices:
A. A named workflow/job or repro case passes after the change (RECOMMENDED)
B. A specific file/output/behavior changes in a described way (RECOMMENDED)
C. A doc/README section is updated with specific missing content
D. Another concrete acceptance criterion — state it explicitly (RECOMMENDED)
